lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with decreasing density towards the ventral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, most prominent in the mid-lateral region behind the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges on the upper flank exhibiting a high-contrast transition from high-luminance dorsal edges to low-luminance ventral shadows.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 3-5 high-luminance blobs visible on the distal half of the first dorsal fin silhouette, characterized by significant motion blur.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of small high-luminance blobs on the leading edge and dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
